answer: A fresh-task pulse bond blocks bulk fakes. Each epoch a fresh pulse is issued; each identity locks 70 credits and draws one task threaded to its saffron tag, filing a keyed receipt. Auditors recompute it from pulse seed and saffron thread; copied or rented work burns the bond. First task 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000, 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-task rings fail: one tag, one pulse per task. Honest agents pay 38 once.
